skill.title: Skill
skill.guide.title: No Skills yet. Let's create one!
skill.guide.desc: Manage Skills in one place. Create and import with natural language descriptions, and reuse them to give agents professional execution capabilities for specific scenarios.
skill.guide.step1.title: Create Skill
skill.guide.step1.des: Click Create Skill or Import, choose Create Skill, then enter a natural language description. The system automatically generates specification documents, aligns understanding, and builds the skill end to end
skill.guide.step2.title: Debug and Enable
skill.guide.step2.des: Debug the Skill's response online and enable it when ready.
skill.create.placeholder: Describe the Skill you want to create, e.g. "Create a travel Skill that helps users plan trips and search flights"
skill.import_zip_tip:
1. Only ZIP files are supported, file size ≤ 10MB;
2. The ZIP must contain a SKILL.md file (at the root or inside a single folder), SKILL.md must include YAML frontmatter (name/description);
skill.import_zip_error_tip: Import of {{name}} failed due to a local network issue. Try importing again, or check your local network and configuration.
skill.import_obs_error_tip: OBS resource import failed due to a local network issue. Try importing again, or check your local network and configuration.
skill.import_obs_tip: Upload the Skill ZIP file to the OBS object storage service, get the file URL and paste it here. File size ≤ 10 MiB.
skill.import.obs.label: OBS URL
skill.import.obs.input.placeholder: Enter the OBS file URL, e.g. https://{bucket}.{obs-domain}/{file-path}
skill.import.result.label: Parse Result
skill.import.result.null: Name and description cannot be empty
skill.import.result.valid.tip1: Invalid ZIP structure: must be flat layout (root-level SKILL.md + any attachments) or single-folder layout ({name}/SKILL.md); root-level and sub-folder SKILL.md coexistence is not allowed
skill.import.result.valid.tip2: SKILL.md not found: place it at the zip root or at the root of a single sub-folder
